issues.description: PKGBUILD is Arch Linux-specific (pacman-based). Alpine uses apk/PKG build files. CLI help text references 'CachyOS PKGBUILD dir'.

issues.type: systemd service references in CLI help text
issues.description: CLI help text references systemd .service unit names. Alpine uses OpenRC runlevels/scripts. persist.rs auto-detects init system, but CLI help strings still say '.service'
Help text references 'initramfs' and 'initcpio' (Arch/Dracut terminology). Alpine uses a different initramfs mechanism (mkimage/initramfs).
CLI prints mkinitcpio -P. Fixed: now reads /etc/alpine-release, shows 'mkimage' for Alpine, 'mkinitcpio -P' for Arch.

issues.type: Arch install instructions in error message
issues.description: Error message for cu health-test shows PKGBUILD/makepkg + pacman install instructions for umr and RADV. Alpine users need apk-based install instructions.
The phrase 'boot re-apply service' uses generic terminology. Alpine users expect OpenRC runlevel/script references.

The install() function writes a systemd .service unit file with systemd directives (Type=oneshot, RemainAfterExit=yes, WantedBy=multi-user.target). Alpine uses OpenRC runscripts. persist.rs was converted but cores.rs install() was not.

acpi_install() and acpi_revert() are entirely Arch-specific: references to /etc/mkinitcpio.conf, parsing HOOKS=(...) syntax, injecting 'acpi_override' hook, running 'mkinitcpio -P'. These functions are unusable on Alpine.
